feeds.role: package sources of the base distribution

feed_revision_note: The feed revisions are the branch heads of the source commit date, so the build input does not drift with the moving branches. No device feed is needed: every package of the requirement table exists in the base feeds.

image.image_size_note: IMAGE_SIZE := 110592k is the upper bound of the factory image, not a measured size. The UBI partition of the partition contract is 112 MiB, so the image has about 4 MiB of head room.

partition_contract.source: the same 112M device tree that the boot loader lock uses

packages.backend: xray-core and xray-plugin from the packages feed

packages.detail: sing-box does not exist in the openwrt-21.02 package feed and modern releases need a Go toolchain the 21.02 base does not provide. PassWall 4.68 only offers the xray backend. The requirement is met with xray and the difference is recorded instead of shipping a second proxy manager.
There is no LuCI application for cloudflared in this feed. The tunnel is configured at deployment time from the command line and the service stays disabled until a configuration file exists.
The providers ship inside ddns-scripts in this base. The service provider and the domain are entered at deployment time.
The daemon and the command line client are available, the LuCI application is not part of the openwrt-21.02 luci feed. The overlay network is configured with the shipped client.

system_dependencies.detail: The base reads the WAN MAC with mtd_get_mac_ascii from the pdt_data_1 partition and derives the LAN MAC from it.
system_dependencies.impact: The 112M partition contract has no pdt_data_1 partition, so the stock source of the MAC does not exist on this layout. The device patch takes the MAC from a provisioned file, then from the factory data area, and only then from the stock partition when it is still there.

system_dependencies.detail: When the first two bytes at offset 4 of the Factory partition are 00-0c, the base writes a MAC derived from the WAN MAC into the Factory partition at offset 4.
system_dependencies.impact: The first boot can modify the factory data area, so the area has to be backed up before the system is started. The patch keeps this behaviour but only when a real WAN MAC was found.
